description: Unreal Tournament (GOTY, 1999; OldUnreal v469e native Linux)
long: Unreal Tournament is a fast-paced arena first-person shooter centered on competitive deathmatch and team modes like Capture the Flag, Domination, and Assault. The single-player ladder pits the player against AI bots, while the multiplayer supports online and LAN play. It was developed by Epic Games and Digital Extremes and published by GT Interactive; this build uses the OldUnreal v469e native Linux patch.
